messages:
maya: Heads-up — CI started failing for the Orpheus-3B eval onboarding job after we enabled q4f quantization. Failing test is the chat-template suite (chat_templates/orpheus_default.json).
ci-bot: Pipeline failed: eval-runner 0.9.2 -> job 6721 exited with code 1. Logs: `TokenizationError: unexpected token sequence at offset 0`
maya: here's the offending system prompt we saw in the logs (note the invisible char at the start):
```
\uFEFFYou are a helpful assistant that prefers concise answers.
```
emma: :eyes: that leading BOM (U+FEFF) often trips our tokenizer normalization. Some builds strip unicode normalization by default, others don't.
raj: Can repro locally. If I cat -A the template file I get `^?You are a helpful assistant...` which is the BOM. Our tokenizer's `pre_tokenize` doesn't strip BOMs currently for non-utf8-normalized files.
oliver: quick workaround: run a pre-step in the runner to normalize templates: `sed -i '1s/\xEF\xBB\xBF//' chat_templates/orpheus_default.json` then re-run. But we should fix in code.
sophie: Related question — the dashboard shows no metric points for "response_quality@prefix" for this run. Did the BOM cause the eval to abort before emitting metrics? :thinking:
maya: yes, the runner crashed before producing any reference-grounded metrics. The harness writes NaN when tokenization fails and the dashboard pipeline drops NaNs, so you see nothing.
raj: Proposed fix: add a defensive strip step in the model config loader and also emit a metric status tag so the dashboard can show failed-to-tokenize events instead of dropping. Example patch: 
```json
{
  "model": "orpheus-3b-q4f",
  "onboard": {
    "strip_bom": true,
    "normalize_unicode": "NFKC",
    "emit_metric_on_error": "tokenization_failure"
  }
}
```
emma: I like `emit_metric_on_error`. Even if numeric metrics are NaN, a status counter helps ops triage.
oliver: I'll open a tiny PR to add BOM stripping at eval-harness/io.py:load_template() and wire emit_metric_on_error into the metric-collector.
maya: thanks. Can we also add a CI unit that injects a BOM into one template file so this doesn't regress?
raj: yes, adding `test_templates/test_bom_injection.json` in the ci-suite. Test will assert runner returns status `tokenization_failure` and that metrics pipeline emits the counter.
sophie: Will the dashboard ingestion change require a migrations step? The metrics pipeline currently drops NaN series.
raj: Minimal change: map NaN -> null, and create a separate tag-series `error_kind` for the run. Dashboard query will then show counts by `error_kind`. I'll coordinate with eng-infra to deploy the ingestion tweak.
ci-bot: Created ticket INFRA-1298 to update metrics ingestion rules. Linked PR: https://git.company/infra/ingest/pulls/72 :white_check_mark:
maya: repro steps I'm using (local):
```bash
# checkout branch
git checkout fix/bom-strip-eval
# build image
docker build -t eval-runner:local .
# run single template
docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/chat_templates:/app/chat_templates eval-runner:local \
  --model orpheus-3b-q4f --template chat_templates/orpheus_default.json --emit-metrics
```
oliver: ran that and confirmed the runner now returns `exit code 0` with the patch, and the metric `tokenization_failure:0` is emitted.
emma: can we include a tiny note in the onboarding docs about file encodings and our recommended editor settings (utf-8 without BOM)?
maya: yes please — I'll add a short section to the model-onboarding checklist.
raj: leaving a follow-up: we should also audit existing chat templates for uncommon invisible chars (BOM, LTR/RTL marks). I can write a small script to scan all templates.
sophie: awesome. once INFRA-1298 is live let's re-run the failing CI job.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll queue the PR review and add the CI test. :thumbsup:
oliver: ping me on the PR, I'll help validate the ingestion change once infra deploys.
ci-bot: Pipeline re-run scheduled (job 6721-rerun)
maya: (closing) will update thread when CI passes.
